description:
Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI) — weekly container shipping rate
benchmark from Shanghai for major lanes, published Fridays by the Shanghai
Shipping Exchange. No official API; data is fetched from the JSON XHR endpoint
the public web page calls. Covers Comprehensive Index plus 15 lane indices
including Mediterranean, Persian Gulf/Red Sea, India/Pakistan, USWC, USEC,
Europe, Australia, Japan, South America, and West/East Africa.

tools.name: scfi_current
tools.description: Fetch the current weekly SCFI (Comprehensive Index plus all 15 lane sub-indices). Required: indexName (default: scfi). Returns the SCFIResponse.

params.name: indexName
params.description: Index identifier. Always 'scfi' for SCFI; the endpoint also serves CCFI ('ccfi') and other SSE indices.
